description: Bug report from a consumer of agent-harness: our cost report marked a trial as fully priced, but its token counts were incomplete. The result came from agent-harness and passed contract.validate_result with usage_completeness "complete", although its usage summary (cache_semantics "separate") had a null cache_read_tokens. Find out which results are wrongly accepted as complete and fix agent-harness. Change src/agent_harness/ only.
environment: Python >= 3.9 stdlib; base tree = agent-harness af994d7 without .github, no repository history
visible_checks: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest tests.test_contract tests.test_boundaries (from the workspace root)
provenance: real fix: agent-harness commit 2ada5ffe25c5b95e42842577b494cc5dd69cff8e (fix(contract): require integer units for complete usage, 2026-10-05), base = its parent af994d7; reference/good.patch is that commit's src diff; hidden cases authored for agent-benchmark from the commit's test change (2026-10-10). Public repository, created after typical model training cutoffs but readable online: contamination possible for models with browsing or later training data; bug-report variant v2 (2026-10-11): own bundle, hidden cases use cache_semantics separate so the expected split does not depend on how unknown semantics or the golden fixtures are read (v1 was ambiguous and its runs are invalidated); v3 (2026-10-17): the v2 case complete_without_summary had a second reading consistent with ADR 0002 (without a summary the stream events are the usage) and is replaced by a stream-only case with a null unit, which both readings reject, plus a case where a summary with integer units overrides a stream event with a null unit (ADR 0002: a summary is authoritative); reference/stream_fallback.patch (a Codex candidate from the 2026-10-14 run) covers the second reading; v2 grades stay as recorded
